scope: Make the main top action resume a processingError-paused batch from the failed image.
behavior: When analysisPause is active, the main button label becomes 停止した画像から再開.
Clicking it reuses retryProcessingFailure for the paused result instead of runAll, so the failed image is retried first and the remaining batch continues on success.
During retry/manual commit/checkpoint restore the main button is disabled and shows 再開中… when applicable.
After checkpoint restore finishes, a paused batch exposes the top resume action immediately.
Failure-card recovery actions remain available and unchanged.
guardrails: No changes to processingError pause position or checkpoint contents.
Normal 解析する behavior remains unchanged when no pause exists.
